infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SHEREHE uses the camera so hosts can scan guest QR passes at the door and guests can capture event photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SHEREHE needs photo library access so you can pick a cover image for your event invitation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SHEREHE saves event photos and shared gallery downloads to your library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SHEREHE accesses your contacts so you can quickly add guests to your event invitations without typing every email or phone number manually.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: SHEREHE sends RSVP reminders, event countdowns and gallery-unlock alerts.
